frames.narration: Both threads start at about the same time. The field is still empty.
Thread A makes the first check without a lock, sees null and takes the lock.
Thread B also saw null. It tries the lock and has to wait.
Thread A checks again inside the lock: still null. It builds the object and publishes the reference safely.
A releases the lock. B gets it and does the second check. The field is no longer null, so B creates nothing.
A later thread makes the first check, sees the instance and returns at once, without touching the lock.
